description: This file defines API endpoints for managing defects in a defect tracking system, including CRUD operations, image uploads, and defect listing with filtering/sorting.

methods.name: Defect _defect_row_to_model(row: dict)
methods.description: Converts a database row dictionary to a Defect model, including transforming image metadata.

methods.name: list_defects_endpoint( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query across title/description/root_cause"), status: Optional[DefectStatus] = Query(None, description="Filter by defect status"), severity: Optional[Severity] = Query(None, description="Filter by severity"), limit: int = Query(25, ge=1, le=200, description="Page size"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Offset for pagination"), sort: str = Query("updated_at", description="Sort key: created_at, updated_at, due_date, severity, status"), order: str = Query("desc", description="Sort order: asc or desc"), conn=Depends(db_session), )
methods.description: Handles GET request to list or search defects with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create_defect_endpoint(payload: DefectCreate, conn=Depends(db_session))
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new defect with validation on root cause based on status.

methods.name: get_defect_endpoint(defect_id: int, conn=Depends(db_session))
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific defect by ID.

methods.name: update_defect_endpoint(defect_id: int, payload: DefectUpdate, conn=Depends(db_session))
methods.description: Handles PATCH request to update defect fields, enforcing workflow transitions and validation.

methods.name: delete_defect_endpoint(defect_id: int, conn=Depends(db_session))
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a defect and associated data.

methods.name: upload_defect_image_base64_endpoint(defect_id: int, payload: ImageUploadBase64Request, conn=Depends(db_session))
methods.description: Handles POST request to upload a defect image via base64 encoding.

methods.name: upload_defect_image_multipart_endpoint( defect_id: int, file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Image file"), conn=Depends(db_session) )
methods.description: Handles POST request to upload a defect image via multipart form-data.
